extDescription.message: Record UI steps with a screenshot each, capture API calls, and file the bug in Redmine.

sessionsEmptyStart.message: No sessions yet. Click Start above.

sessionsEmptyPopup.message: No sessions yet. Click Start above.

popupHint.message: The switches next to recording turn off clicks, screenshots, keyboard, Vue, Console, or requests at any time. Request scope defaults to This tab and can be set to All tabs. Requests to the configured Redmine URL are never recorded.

popupDebugger.message: The debugger did not attach (you may have clicked Cancel). This session records request metadata only, without response bodies.

confirmDelete.message: Delete this session and all of its screenshots and records?

noteNeedRecording.message: Start recording first. The note is stored on the current session.

noteNotWritten.message: Nothing was saved (recording may not have started)

devtoolsFallback1.message: This is the Bug Recorder DevTools entry page. It is normally hidden.

devtoolsFallback2.message: The panel should appear as the Bug Recorder tab at the top of DevTools. If it does not, open about:debugging, inspect this extension, and look for [Bug Recorder] in the console.

rangeHint.message: Click a screenshot below to jump to that page step

originTitle.message: Separate notes you typed from events recorded automatically

sortTitlePanel.message: Sort page steps by start time

timelineEmpty.message: After you start recording, each step's screenshot appears here in order. Click one to jump to its page step, or select a range to submit only that range.

rangeStart.message: Start $1 selected. Click the end screenshot.

rangeSpan.message: Range $1 ~ $2 (about $3 steps). You can submit this range.

rangeHow.message: Click two screenshots: the first is the start, the second is the end.

rangeNeedBoth.message: Click a start screenshot and an end screenshot first

rangeNoSession.message: Session is not ready (recording has not started), so a range cannot be set

rangeWriteEmpty.message: Saved range could not be read back

rangeSaved.message: Range saved. The submit page is open.

pageCheckTitle.message: Select every step on this page ($1 steps, $2 selected)

pageMeta.message: $1 · $2 steps / $3 API$4 · $5/$6 selected · click for details

phKey.message: From the bottom of Redmine → My account

labelBodies.message: Capture API response bodies (also turn on Requests above; Chrome only, and the browser shows a debugging banner)

emptySession.message: Pick a session on the left, or click Start and use the app under test. While recording, each click and input is screenshotted. Come back here to file the bug.

timelineTitle.message: Timeline (URL is a page step · actions, API, Console, and Pinia are interleaved · check the steps to submit)

phSearch.message: Filter page steps (URL, title, step text, API path)

sortTitle.message: Page-step order (order inside a page stays the same)

labelProjectManual.message: Or type a project identifier / ID

labelDescription.message: Description (generated from the checked steps; you can edit it)

projectsEmpty.message: The project list is empty and the API is reachable (this is not a 404). Redmine only returns projects this account can see. Make the account a member of at least one project, or type the project identifier or numeric ID below.

copyFailed.message: Copy failed. Select the text and copy it manually.

needProject.message: Load and choose a project, or type the identifier from the project URL (or its numeric ID).

updateHint.message: Updating #$1: the subject and description of this issue will change, and attachments will be added. A new issue will not be created.

selInfo.message: $1 / $2 steps selected (unchecked steps are left out of the description and screenshots)

confirmDeleteStep.message: Delete this step? Only this session's record is affected.

confirmDeletePage.message: Delete the whole page "$1"? That removes $2 steps, requests, and events on this page.

deletePageTitle.message: Delete every record on this page (steps, API, Pinia)

pageCheckShort.message: Select steps on this page ($1/$2 selected)

resMissing.message: Response body not captured (turn on Capture API response bodies; Chrome only)

capShotTitle.message: Screenshot the viewport after each action

capConsoleTitle.message: Record console.log / info / warn / error and uncaught errors

capRequestTitle.message: Record XHR / fetch. Scope is This tab or All tabs beside this.

capScopeTitle.message: This tab records only the tab you are looking at. All tabs includes the others. Requests to the Redmine URL in settings are never recorded.

reportBefore.message: > $1 requests/events from before recording. See the timeline appendix.

reportFooter.message: > Generated by Bug Recorder for Redmine. Actions and API calls are merged on one timeline. Steps and screenshots were confirmed by the tester.

errNeedSettings.message: Set the Redmine URL and API key in Settings first

errIssueMissing.message: $1 $2This issue does not exist, or the current account cannot see it.

errProjectMissing.message: $1 $2Project not found. Use the numeric ID or the identifier from the URL, not the display name. The Redmine URL must be the site root.

errNotFound.message: $1 $2Use the site root (no /projects or /issues) and make sure the REST API is enabled.

errProjects.message: This is not an API version mismatch. Project lists from Redmine 1.0 onward are GET /projects.json, and a version mismatch does not return 404. The request was $1/projects.json and that address is not on the server. Set the URL to the Redmine home page root, keeping any sub-path (for example http://host/redmine), save, and load again.

errUploads.message: Both /uploads.json and /uploads returned 404. Use the site root (for example https://redmine.example.com) and enable REST under Administration → Settings → API. You can also uncheck attachments and submit text only.

errScheme.message: The Redmine URL must start with http:// or https://
